# Tai Chi Please: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-07 · code d5cee8bc7f91 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Gentle morning tai chi in a bamboo forest: guided sessions with a 3D teacher, qigong, lymph self-massage and the 24-step form. Start without signing up.
**Live:** https://tai-chi-please.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/tai-chi-please · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `tai-chi-please/.claude/skills/taichiplease/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py taichiplease` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Engines stay JavaScript** (theme/assets, moved unchanged from the old web/pages/_*.html): `tc-figure.js` (TC.Figure: the
  3D teacher, IK + projected SVG; TC.stage bamboo backdrop; bell, wind), `tc-moves.js` (all 43 moves: text + keyframes,
  TC.FORM24, TC.STAGES, TC.compose = session recipes, TC.local = guest sessions in localStorage), `tc-voice.js` (recorded
  Kokoro clips theme/assets/vo-<hash>.mp3 + TC.music via ArkMusic), `tc-state.js` (grove SVG, hero frame for stills, .ics
  reminder), `ark-music.js` (synced copy, don't edit). **`tc-ui.js`** is new: `TC.mountStage` (used by Components/Stage),
  `TC.lymphMap`, `TC.catalogJSON` (the move library as JSON for Python), and **`TC.player`** = the guided session
  (clock, steps lighting up, breathing orb, voice rules in voiceKey(), wake lock, keys). Python reaches it through
  `client_code/tc.py` and Pages/Session (hooks done/toast/pref; `player.state/begin/finish/play/hold/setPref/feelBefore/stop`).
- **Session page has no Shell** (full screen). Intro, "Finish here?" (an alert with three buttons) and the done screen are
  Forms; the player draws only into the dom-nodes stage/bar/panel/ctl/left. `leave()` (router) stops sound + wake lock.
  Test hooks: `window.TC.session.{state, next, finish, skipAhead}`.
- **Prefs/progress in Python** (`tc.py`): prefs live in localStorage `taichiplease.prefs` (read with json, not UI.store) and
  in `users.prefs` when signed in (`save_prefs`); guests' progress comes from `taichiplease.guest.sessions`; Today imports
  them into the account (`import_guest_sessions`). Days are the browser's local date (`TC.today()`).
- **Components/Stage** makes its figure on `show` and stops it on `hide` (a figure whose SVG leaves the page stops itself);
  put it inside a `.tc-stage` div. Learn's thumbnails are 43 still Stages (`still=True`, TC.heroTime picks the frame).
- **Voice**: changing any spoken text (a move's name/steps/tip, TC.CUES) needs `python tools/make_voice.py` (Kokoro;
  reads the lines from tc-figure/moves/voice.js). All 200 lines have clips.
- Contrast facelift: `--c-faint` #5c695d / #829386, `--c-good` #2c774b, `--c-warn` #925d00, dark `--c-seal` #b4432f
  (white seal text). `.ic` is the icon-mask class: card icon wrappers are `.icw`.
- Smoke test: `python -I tools/ui_test.py --only smoke.js` (signed out incl. a guest session to the done screen, a member
  session logged to the journal, every admin tab; the admin is arkulinskis@gmail.com, first sign-up becomes admin).
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/make_voice.py`: Record the teacher's voice: one MP3 per spoken line, in theme/assets/vo-<hash>.mp3.
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
